messages:
Zoe: Quick doc ask — can we add a micro-section about "isolation decorators and preemption windows" in the Dedicated provisioning guide? Support sees customers surprised when preemption + fallback interact. cc @peter @kevin

Peter: Yep, short and practical. I suggest: (1) explain isolation decorator semantics (no-preempt / best-effort), (2) show a tiny YAML and CLI to set it, (3) note how preemption order relates to fallback routing.

Kevin: Draft YAML (keeps keys explicit):
```yaml
provisioning:
  tenant: delta-team
  reserved_capacity:
    gpus: 6
    model: rdl-large-v2
  scalePolicy:
    target_qps: 180
    cooldown_s: 90  # seconds
    fallbackModel: rdl-medium-q2
    fallback_policy:
      max_fallback_pct: 20
  isolation_decorators:
    preemption: no-preempt  # options: no-preempt | preempt-low | preempt-any
    min_reserved_on_fallback: 0.7  # fraction of reserved pool to keep before allowing fallback routing
```

Zoe: Nice. The new keys `isolation_decorators` and `min_reserved_on_fallback` are diagnostic-only defaults in the doc (we'll note they are opt-in).

SRE-Jen: Ops notes to include: (1) when preemption=preempt-low, unreserved best-effort tasks may be evicted before fallback is considered; (2) min_reserved_on_fallback prevents fallback routing until X% of reserved capacity is free — useful to avoid fallback stealing steady-state reserved traffic.

Kevin: CLI snippet to toggle decorator for a tenant:
```bash
redwoodctl provision update --tenant delta-team --set isolation_decorators.preemption=no-preempt --set isolation_decorators.min_reserved_on_fallback=0.7
```

Peter: Add a short SDK example showing per-request behavior override (Python):
```python
resp = client.generate(
  model='rdl-large-v2',
  prompt='Translate to FR',
  routing_preferences={'allow_fallback': True},
  tenant_meta={'isolation_decorator': 'no-preempt'}
)
```

Zoe: Two quick troubleshooting bullets to add (FAQ style):
- "Why did my tenant still get preempted?" -> Explain that cluster-wide preemption policies or node-level eviction (OOM) can override tenant decorator; check eviction_reason in recent logs.
- "Why did fallback route before eviction?" -> Check min_reserved_on_fallback vs ReservedCapacityUtilization; fallback can be allowed if reserved headroom is below the min threshold.

SRE-Jen: Metrics to recommend in the micro-section: ReservedCapacityUtilization, EvictionEvents{tenant}, and FallbackRoutedPct. Also tell readers to enable full-trace for 10m when debugging decorator interactions.

Kevin: Add one-line legal/ops note: decorators do not change contractual reserved throughput; they only affect eviction ordering and routing heuristics. Billing unchanged.
